title: Add planning trace coverage graph support
summary: Add trace/read-model support so decision coverage and roadmap reconciliation states are queryable and auditable.

goal.outcome: Trace/graph views expose decision coverage and roadmap reconciliation states for implemented, deferred, superseded, unmapped, and replanned work.
acceptance: Planning build/trace readers preserve `decision_coverage` and `roadmap_reconciliation` evidence.
Graph or lint lens reports unmapped accepted decision rows/questions when no coverage exists.
Graph/lens distinguishes implemented, deferred, superseded, no-work, and active roadmap coverage.
Tests cover trace/read-model extraction and warning/finding output.
non_goals: Do not migrate all source roots in this task.
Do not purge legacy builds or validation reports.
Do not implement planning-gate policy checks already owned by TASK-107.
